diagnosis: The proof fails only in the complement bijection: `simp_all` repeatedly uses the large local context and reaches the recursion-depth limit while proving double-complement identities. Replacing it with four explicit `card_bij'` obligations and plain `simp` avoids the loop and reduces elaboration work.
proof_body:
by
  classical
  have hmax (A : Set S) (hA : ∀ U ∈ P, A ∩ U ≠ ∅) : A ∈ P := by
    by_contra hnA
    exact hPS ⟨A, hnA, hA⟩
  have hmem (A : Set S) : A ∈ P ↔ Aᶜ ∉ P := by
    constructor
    · intro hA hAc
      exact hPP A hA Aᶜ hAc (by simp)
    · intro hAc
      by_contra hA
      have hnA : ¬∀ U ∈ P, A ∩ U ≠ ∅ := fun h => hA (hmax A h)
      have hnAc : ¬∀ V ∈ P, Aᶜ ∩ V ≠ ∅ := fun h => hAc (hmax Aᶜ h)
      push_neg at hnA hnAc
      obtain ⟨U, hU, hAU⟩ := hnA
      obtain ⟨V, hV, hAcV⟩ := hnAc
      have hUA : ∀ x ∈ U, x ∉ A := by
        intro x hxU hxA
        have hx : x ∈ A ∩ U := ⟨hxA, hxU⟩
        simpa [hAU] using hx
      have hVA : ∀ x ∈ V, x ∈ A := by
        intro x hxV
        by_contra hxA
        have hx : x ∈ Aᶜ ∩ V := ⟨by simpa, hxV⟩
        simpa [hAcV] using hx
      apply hPP U hU V hV
      apply Set.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem
      rintro x ⟨hxU, hxV⟩
      exact hUA x hxU (hVA x hxV)
  let Q : Finset (Set S) := Finset.univ \ P
  have hPQ : ∀ A ∈ P, Aᶜ ∈ Q := by
    intro A hA
    simpa [Q] using (hmem A).mp hA
  have hQP : ∀ A ∈ Q, Aᶜ ∈ P := by
    intro A hA
    have hnA : A ∉ P := by simpa [Q] using hA
    apply (hmem Aᶜ).mpr
    simpa using hnA
  have hc : P.card = Q.card := by
    apply Finset.card_bij' (fun A _ => Aᶜ) (fun A _ => Aᶜ)
    · exact hPQ
    · exact hQP
    · intro A hA
      simp
    · intro A hA
      simp
  have hsum : P.card + Q.card = (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)).card := by
    rw [← Finset.card_union_add_card_inter P Q]
    have hi : P ∩ Q = ∅ := by
      ext A
      simp [Q]
    have hu : P ∪ Q = (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)) := by
      ext A
      simp [Q]
    rw [hi, hu]
    simp
  have hall : (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)).card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    simp
  have hdouble : P.card * 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    calc
      P.card * 2 = P.card + P.card := by omega
      _ = P.card + Q.card := by rw [hc]
      _ = (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)).card := hsum
      _ = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := hall
  have hn : 0 < Fintype.card S := Fintype.card_pos
  have hpow : 2 ^ Fintype.card S = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 := by
    calc
      2 ^ Fintype.card S = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1 + 1) :=
        congrArg (fun k : ℕ => 2 ^ k) (by omega)
      _ = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 := by rw [pow_succ]
  have hcanc : P.card * 2 = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 := hdouble.trans hpow
  omega
